system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that can create and update listings for a seller.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Gaming keyboard listing - create then update workflow

prompts.prompt_text: I just got a new shipment of gaming keyboards from my supplier and need to create a listing. Please create a listing for seller SELLER001 with SKU 'GAMING-KB-RGB01', title 'ProGamer RGB Mechanical Keyboard', price $129.99, and make it active in the US marketplace. This is a hot product for the upcoming gaming season.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM listings_items WHERE seller_id = 'SELLER001' AND sku = 'GAMING-KB-RGB01' AND price = 129.99 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND title = 'ProGamer RGB Mechanical Keyboard'

scenarios.name: S2
scenarios.description: Gaming keyboard listing - create then update workflow

prompts.prompt_text: Now I need to update this keyboard price to $119.99 (we're running a launch promotion) and change the title to 'ProGamer RGB Mechanical Keyboard - Limited Time Offer'. Also make sure it's available in both US and CA marketplaces.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM listings_items WHERE seller_id = 'SELLER001' AND sku = 'GAMING-KB-RGB01' AND price = 119.99 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND title LIKE '%Limited Time Offer%'

scenarios.name: S3
scenarios.description: Laptop inventory listing with tool restrictions

prompts.prompt_text: I need to list my existing TechPro X15 Laptop inventory. Please create a listing for seller SELLER001 with SKU 'LAPTOP-XP15', title 'TechPro X15 Laptop', price $899.99, quantity 125, and make it active for sale. This matches my current inventory levels.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM listings_items WHERE seller_id = 'SELLER001' AND sku = 'LAPTOP-XP15' AND price = 899.99 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND title LIKE '%TechPro X15%'
